{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu_carry_prefix #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] p,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] g,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] carry_in
);
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(WIDTH);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] gp [0:LEVELS];
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] gg [0:LEVELS];
    assign gp[0] = p;
    assign gg[0] = g;
    genvar level, bit_index;
    generate
        for (level = 0; level < LEVELS; level = level + 1) begin: prefix_level
            for (bit_index = 0; bit_index < WIDTH; bit_index = bit_index + 1) begin: prefix_bit
                if (bit_index >= (1 << level)) begin: combine
                    assign gp[level+1][bit_index] = gp[level][bit_index] & gp[level][bit_index-(1 << level)];
                    assign gg[level+1][bit_index] = gg[level][bit_index] | (gp[level][bit_index] & gg[level][bit_index-(1 << level)]);
                end else begin: passthrough
                    assign gp[level+1][bit_index] = gp[level][bit_index];
                    assign gg[level+1][bit_index] = gg[level][bit_index];
                end
            end
        end
        for (bit_index = 0; bit_index < WIDTH; bit_index = bit_index + 1) begin: carry_output
            if (bit_index == 0) begin: low_bit
                assign carry_in[bit_index] = 1'b0;
            end else begin: upper_bit
                assign carry_in[bit_index] = gg[LEVELS][bit_index-1];
            end
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bit_xor;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] carry_add, borrow_ab, borrow_ba;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_value, sub_ab_value, sub_ba_value;
    wire select_add, select_ab, select_ba;
    wire select_or, select_and, select_xor, select_xnor;
    assign bit_xor = a ^ b;
    pw_alu_carry_prefix #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) add_prefix (
        .p(bit_xor), .g(a & b), .carry_in(carry_add)
    );
    pw_alu_carry_prefix #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) ab_prefix (
        .p(~bit_xor), .g((~a) & b), .carry_in(borrow_ab)
    );
    pw_alu_carry_prefix #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) ba_prefix (
        .p(~bit_xor), .g(a & (~b)), .carry_in(borrow_ba)
    );
    assign add_value = bit_xor ^ carry_add;
    assign sub_ab_value = bit_xor ^ borrow_ab;
    assign sub_ba_value = bit_xor ^ borrow_ba;
    assign select_add = (Oper == 3'b000);
    assign select_ab = (Oper == 3'b001);
    assign select_ba = (Oper == 3'b010);
    assign select_or = (Oper == 3'b011);
    assign select_and = (Oper == 3'b100);
    assign select_xor = (Oper == 3'b101);
    assign select_xnor = (Oper == 3'b110);
    always @* begin
        sum = ({WIDTH{select_add}} & add_value)
            | ({WIDTH{select_ab}} & sub_ab_value)
            | ({WIDTH{select_ba}} & sub_ba_value)
            | ({WIDTH{select_or}} & (a | b))
            | ({WIDTH{select_and}} & (a & b))
            | ({WIDTH{select_xor}} & bit_xor)
            | ({WIDTH{select_xnor}} & (~bit_xor));
    end
endmodule

module pw_pipeline_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32,
    parameter STAGES = 2
)(
    input wire clk, rst,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    input wire in_valid,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] result,
    output wire out_valid
);
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] operand_a, operand_b;
    reg [2:0] opcode;
    reg input_valid;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] alu_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] stage_data [0:STAGES-2];
    wire stage_valid [0:STAGES-2];

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            operand_a <= 0;
            operand_b <= 0;
            opcode <= 0;
            input_valid <= 0;
        end else begin
            operand_a <= a;
            operand_b <= b;
            opcode <= Oper;
            input_valid <= in_valid;
        end
    end

    pw_alu #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) alu (
        .a(operand_a), .b(operand_b), .Oper(opcode), .sum(alu_result)
    );

    genvar index;
    generate
        for (index = 0; index < STAGES-1; index = index+1) begin: output_pipeline
            reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_reg;
            reg valid_reg;
            wire [WIDTH-1:0] next_data;
            wire next_valid;
            if (index == 0) begin: first_stage
                assign next_data = alu_result;
                assign next_valid = input_valid;
            end else begin: following_stage
                assign next_data = stage_data[index-1];
                assign next_valid = stage_valid[index-1];
            end
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                if (rst) begin
                    data_reg <= 0;
                    valid_reg <= 0;
                end else begin
                    data_reg <= next_data;
                    valid_reg <= next_valid;
                end
            end
            assign stage_data[index] = data_reg;
            assign stage_valid[index] = valid_reg;
        end
    endgenerate
    assign result = stage_data[STAGES-2];
    assign out_valid = stage_valid[STAGES-2];
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The targeted path is operand register through 16-bit addition or subtraction and operation selection to the first output register. Long carry or borrow propagation can dominate setup timing.",
  "rewrite": "Replace inferred arithmetic with three parallel logarithmic-depth prefix networks: addition carry, a-minus-b borrow, and b-minus-a borrow. Share the operand XOR and subtraction propagation signals. Select completed arithmetic and logic results with decoded, mutually exclusive operation masks. All sequential RTL and named state remain unchanged.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "At WIDTH=16, each carry or borrow network has at most four prefix-combination levels rather than a linear propagation chain. This targets improved setup WNS without moving work across register boundaries. Actual gain depends on synthesis mapping and routing; no measured STA improvement is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Parallel prefix logic increases intermediate wiring and may increase combinational area and switching. Shared XOR and subtraction propagation logic reduce duplication, and unused prefix outputs can be pruned. Compliance with the 4573.511360um2 cap and electrical constraints requires mapped implementation checks; these have not been run.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves unsigned WIDTH-bit modulo arithmetic, all seven operations, and zero for opcode 111. No valid-dependent data suppression is introduced. Clock, synchronous reset priority, register names, valid propagation, output latency, parameter defaults, and pipeline structure are unchanged. No initialization, startup assumptions, or extra state are used; repeated resets and invalid-cycle data retain their original behavior."
}
